// about: Recommended runtime for the DevOps kit and the hard boundary (layer L1 in ../SECURITY.md). It mounts ONLY the workspace, sets NO cloud credentials or env, and locks egress to an audited allowlist via init-firewall.sh. A credential file that is not mounted cannot be read; a cloud API that is not allowlisted cannot be reached.
name: claude-code-devops-kit
// security-note: Do NOT add bind mounts for ~/.aws, ~/.azure, ~/.config/gcloud, ~/.kube, ~/.oci, ~/.docker, or ~/.ssh. Do NOT forward cloud env vars (AWS_*, AZURE_*, GOOGLE_*, KUBECONFIG, ...) via remoteEnv/containerEnv. Both would defeat the boundary.
// caps: NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW are needed only so init-firewall.sh can install the egress allowlist, and are dropped from the engineer's shell. The container is otherwise unprivileged.
// postCreate: Install the offline validators and Claude Code. Pin versions in your fork. Claude Code install per https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/setup .
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y iptables ipset jq tflint yamllint hadolint && npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
// postStart: Install the egress firewall on every start, before the engineer uses the container.
// managed-settings: Copy settings/managed-settings.json to /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json in your image build (root-owned), and the hooks to /opt/claude-code-devops-kit/hooks, so the enforced policy is present in the container.
